159   @GET
160   @Path("policies/{id}")
161   @RestQuery(
162       name = "lifeCyclePolicy",
163       description = "Get a lifecycle policy.",
164       returnDescription = "A lifecycle policy as JSON",
165       pathParameters = {
166           @RestParameter(name = "id", isRequired = true, description = "The lifecycle policy identifier",
167               type = STRING),
168       },
169       responses = {
170           @RestResponse(description = "Returns the lifecycle policy.", responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_OK),
171           @RestResponse(description = "The specified lifecycle policy instance does not exist.",
172               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND),
173           @RestResponse(description = "The user doesn't have the rights to make this request.",
174               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN),
175           @RestResponse(description = "The request is invalid or inconsistent.",
176               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST),
177       })
178   public Response getPolicy(
179       @HeaderParam("Accept") String acceptHeader,
180       @PathParam("id") String id) {
181     try {
182       LifeCyclePolicy policy = service.getLifeCyclePolicyById(id);
183 
184       if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(policy.getCronTrigger())) {
185         CronParser unixParser = new CronParser(CronDefinitionBuilder.instanceDefinitionFor(CronType.QUARTZ));
186         Cron cron = unixParser.parse(policy.getCronTrigger());
187         CronMapper cronMapper = CronMapper.fromQuartzToUnix();
188         Cron cron4jCron = cronMapper.map(cron);
189         policy.setCronTrigger(cron4jCron.asString());
190       }
191 
192       return ApiResponseBuilder.Json.ok(acceptHeader, policyToJson(policy));
193     } catch (NotFoundException e) {
194       return ApiResponseBuilder.notFound("Cannot find playlist instance with id '%s'.", id);
195     } catch (UnauthorizedException e) {
196       return Response.status(Response.Status.FORBIDDEN).build();
197     } catch (LifeCycleServiceException e) {
198       return Response.serverError().build();
199     }
200   }

202   @GET
203   @Path("policies")
204   @RestQuery(
205       name = "policies",
206       description = "Get policies. Policies that you do not have read access to will not show up.",
207       returnDescription = "A JSON object containing an array.",
208       restParameters = {
209           @RestParameter(name = "limit", isRequired = false, type = INTEGER,
210               description = "The maximum number of results to return for a single request.", defaultValue = "100"),
211           @RestParameter(name = "offset", isRequired = false, type = INTEGER,
212               description = "The index of the first result to return."),
213           @RestParameter(name = "sort", isRequired = false, type = STRING,
214               description = "Sort the results based upon a sorting criteria. A criteria is specified as a pair such as:"
215                 + "<Sort Name>:ASC or <Sort Name>:DESC. Adding the suffix ASC or DESC sets the order as ascending or"
216                 + "descending order and is mandatory. Sort Name is case sensitive. Supported Sort Names are 'title'"
217               , defaultValue = "title:ASC"),
218       },
219       responses = {
220           @RestResponse(description = "Returns the playlist.", responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_OK),
221           @RestResponse(description = "The request is invalid or inconsistent.",
222               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST),
223       })
224   public Response getPoliciesAsJson(
225       @HeaderParam("Accept") String acceptHeader,
226       @QueryParam("limit") int limit,
227       @QueryParam("offset") int offset,
228       @QueryParam("sort") String sort) throws LifeCycleServiceException {
229     if (offset < 0) {
230       return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
231     }
232 
233     if (limit < 1) {
234       return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
235     }
236 
237     SortCriterion sortCriterion = new SortCriterion("", SortCriterion.Order.None);
238     Optional<String> optSort = Optional.ofNullable(trimToNull(sort));
239     if (optSort.isPresent()) {
240       sortCriterion = SortCriterion.parse(optSort.get());
241 
242       switch (sortCriterion.getFieldName()) {
243         case "title":
244           break;
245         default:
246           logger.info("Unknown sort criteria {}", sortCriterion.getFieldName());
247           return Response.serverError().status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
248       }
249     }
250     List<LifeCyclePolicy> policies = service.getLifeCyclePolicies(limit, offset, sortCriterion);
251 
252     long total = service.getLifeCyclePoliciesTotal();
253 
254     JsonArray policiesJsonArray = new JsonArray();
255     for (LifeCyclePolicy policy : policies) {
256       policiesJsonArray.add(policyToJson(policy));
257     }
258 
259     JsonObject resultJson = new JsonObject();
260     resultJson.addProperty("total", total);
261     resultJson.addProperty("limit", limit);
262     resultJson.addProperty("offset", offset);
263     resultJson.add("results", policiesJsonArray);
264 
265     // Return the response
266     return ApiResponseBuilder.Json.ok(acceptHeader, resultJson);
267   }

326   @GET
327   @Path("policiesForEvent/{eventId}")
328   @RestQuery(
329       name = "policiesForEvent",
330       description = "Get active lifecycle policies that would target the given event were they to be executed now.",
331       returnDescription = "Lifecycle policies",
332       pathParameters = {
333           @RestParameter(name = "eventId", isRequired = true, description = "The lifecycle policy identifier",
334               type = STRING),
335           @RestParameter(name = "limit", description = "The maximum number of results to return for a single request.",
336               isRequired = false, type = RestParameter.Type.INTEGER),
337           @RestParameter(name = "offset", description = "The index of the first result to return.", isRequired = false,
338               type = RestParameter.Type.INTEGER)
339       },
340       responses = {
341           @RestResponse(description = "Returns the lifecycle policies.", responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_OK),
342       })
343   public Response getPoliciesForEvent(@HeaderParam("Accept") String acceptHeader, @PathParam("eventId") String eventId,
344       @QueryParam("limit") int limit, @QueryParam("offset") int offset)
345           throws SearchIndexException, NotFoundException, LifeCycleServiceException {
346     // Set default limit if necessary
347     if (limit < 1) {
348       limit = 100;
349     }
350 
351     // Create a filter with the event id
352     var eventFilter = new EventSearchQueryField(eventId);
353 
354     // Get policies
355     var lifeCyclePolicies = service.getActiveLifeCyclePolicies();
356 
357     // Run filters
358     List<LifeCyclePolicy> policiesForEvent = new ArrayList<>();
359     for (var policy : lifeCyclePolicies) {
360       var targetFilters = policy.getTargetFilters();
361       String catalogFlavor = indexService.getCommonEventCatalogUIAdapter().getFlavor().toString();
362       targetFilters
363           .computeIfAbsent(catalogFlavor, k -> new HashMap<>())
364           .put("uid", eventFilter);
365       var events = service.filterForEvents(targetFilters, limit, offset);
366       if (!events.isEmpty()) {
367         policiesForEvent.add(policy);
368       }
369     }
370 
371     JsonArray policiesJsonArray = new JsonArray();
372     for (LifeCyclePolicy policy : policiesForEvent) {
373       policiesJsonArray.add(policyToJson(policy));
374     }
375     return ApiResponseBuilder.Json.ok(acceptHeader, policiesJsonArray);
376   }

378   @POST
379   @Path("policies")
380   @RestQuery(
381       name = "create",
382       description = "Creates a lifecycle policy.",
383       returnDescription = "The created lifecycle policy.",
384       restParameters = {
385           @RestParameter(name = "title", isRequired = true, description = "Policy Title", type = STRING),
386           @RestParameter(name = "targetType", description = "EVENT, SERIES", isRequired = true, type = STRING,
387               defaultValue = "EVENT"),
388           @RestParameter(name = "action", description = "START_WORKFLOW", isRequired = true, type = STRING,
389               defaultValue = "START_WORKFLOW"),
390           @RestParameter(name = "actionParameters", description = "Depend entirely on the chosen action. JSON. To find "
391               + "how to structure your JSON check the documentation.", isRequired = false, type = TEXT,
392               defaultValue = actionParametersExampleJSON),
393           @RestParameter(name = "actionDate", description = "Required if timing is SPECIFIC_DATE. "
394               + "E.g. 2023-11-30T16:16:47Z", isRequired = false, type = STRING),
395           @RestParameter(name = "cronTrigger", description = "Required if timing is REPEATING. "
396               + "https://www.quartz-scheduler.org/documentation/quartz-2.3.0/tutorials/crontrigger.html",
397               isRequired = false, type = STRING),
398           @RestParameter(name = "timing", description = "SPECIFIC_DATE, REPEATING, ALWAYS", isRequired = true,
399               type = STRING, defaultValue = "SPECIFIC_DATE"),
400           @RestParameter(name = "targetFilters", isRequired = false, description = "Used to select applicable "
401               + "entities. JSON. To find how to structure your JSON check the documentation.", type = TEXT),
402           @RestParameter(name = "accessControlEntries", description = "Which user have what permissions on this "
403               + "policy. JSON. To find how to structure your JSON check the documentation.", isRequired = false,
404               type = TEXT, defaultValue = ""),
405       },
406       responses = {
407           @RestResponse(description = "Policy created.", responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_CREATED),
408           @RestResponse(description = "The user doesn't have the rights to make this request.",
409               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN),
410           @RestResponse(description = "The request is invalid or inconsistent.",
411               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST),
412       })
413   public Response createAsJson(
414       @HeaderParam("Accept") String acceptHeader,
415       @FormParam("title") String title,
416       @FormParam("targetType") String targetType,
417       @FormParam("action") String action,
418       @FormParam("actionParameters") String actionParameters,
419       @FormParam("actionDate") String actionDate,
420       @FormParam("cronTrigger") String cronTrigger,
421       @FormParam("timing") String timing,
422       @FormParam("targetFilters") String targetFilters,
423       @FormParam("accessControlEntries") String accessControlEntries
424   ) {
425     try {
426       // Check if required fields are present
427       if (title == null || title.isEmpty()) {
428         return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
429       }
430       if (targetType == null || targetType.isEmpty()) {
431         return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
432       }
433       if (action == null || action.isEmpty()) {
434         return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
435       }
436       if (timing == null || timing.isEmpty()) {
437         return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
438       }
439 
440       // Check if conditionally required fields are present
441       if (Timing.valueOf(timing) == Timing.SPECIFIC_DATE) {
442         if (actionDate == null || actionDate.isEmpty()) {
443           return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
444         }
445       }
446       if (Timing.valueOf(timing) == Timing.REPEATING) {
447         if (cronTrigger == null || cronTrigger.isEmpty()) {
448           return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
449         }
450       }
451 
452       // Check if cron string is valid
453       if (cronTrigger != null && !cronTrigger.isEmpty()) {
454         CronParser unixParser = new CronParser(CronDefinitionBuilder.instanceDefinitionFor(CronType.UNIX));
455         Cron cron = unixParser.parse(cronTrigger);
456         CronMapper cronMapper = CronMapper.fromUnixToQuartz();
457         Cron cron4jCron = cronMapper.map(cron);
458         cronTrigger = cron4jCron.asString();
459 
460         if (!org.quartz.CronExpression.isValidExpression(cronTrigger)) {
461           return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
462         }
463       }
464 
465       // Check if action parameters are well formed
466       try {
467         if (Action.valueOf(action) == Action.START_WORKFLOW) {
468           StartWorkflowParameters actionParametersParsed = gson.fromJson(actionParameters,
469               StartWorkflowParameters.class);
470           if (actionParametersParsed.getWorkflowId() == null) {
471             return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
472           }
473         }
474       } catch (JsonSyntaxException e) {
475         return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
476       }
477 
478       // Check if ACL is well formed
479       List<LifeCyclePolicyAccessControlEntryImpl> accessControlEntriesParsed = new ArrayList<>();
480       if (accessControlEntries != null && !accessControlEntries.isEmpty()) {
481         try {
482           accessControlEntriesParsed = gson.fromJson(accessControlEntries,
483             new TypeToken<List<LifeCyclePolicyAccessControlEntryImpl>>() { }.getType());
484           if (accessControlEntriesParsed == null) {
485             accessControlEntriesParsed = new ArrayList<>();
486           }
487         } catch (JsonSyntaxException e) {
488           return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
489         }
490       }
491 
492       // Convert filters
493       Map<String, Map<String, EventSearchQueryField<String>>> filtersMap = new HashMap<>();
494       if (targetFilters != null && !targetFilters.isEmpty()) {
495         try {
496           filtersMap = gson.fromJson(targetFilters,
497             new TypeToken<Map<String, Map<String, EventSearchQueryField<String>>> >() { }.getType());
498           if (filtersMap == null) {
499             filtersMap = new HashMap<>();
500           }
501         } catch (JsonSyntaxException e) {
502           return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
503         }
504       }
505 
506       LifeCyclePolicy policy = new LifeCyclePolicyImpl(
507           title,
508           TargetType.valueOf(targetType),
509           Action.valueOf(action),
510           actionParameters,
511           EncodingSchemeUtils.decodeDate(actionDate),
512           cronTrigger,
513           Timing.valueOf(timing),
514           filtersMap,
515           accessControlEntriesParsed
516       );
517 
518       service.createLifeCyclePolicy(policy);
519       return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED).build();
520     } catch (UnauthorizedException e) {
521       return Response.status(Response.Status.FORBIDDEN).build();
522     } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
523       return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
524     } catch (LifeCycleServiceException e) {
525       return Response.serverError().build();
526     }
527   }

529   @PUT
530   @Path("policies/{id}")
531   @RestQuery(
532       name = "update",
533       description = "Updates a lifecycle policy.",
534       returnDescription = "The updated lifecycle policy.",
535       pathParameters = {
536           @RestParameter(name = "id", isRequired = true, description = "Policy identifier", type = STRING)
537       },
538       restParameters = {
539           @RestParameter(name = "title", isRequired = false, description = "Policy Title", type = STRING),
540           @RestParameter(name = "targetType", description = "EVENT, SERIES", isRequired = false, type = STRING),
541           @RestParameter(name = "action", description = "START_WORKFLOW", isRequired = false, type = STRING),
542           @RestParameter(name = "actionParameters", description = "Depend entirely on the chosen action. JSON. To "
543               + "find how to structure your JSON check the documentation.", isRequired = false, type = TEXT),
544           @RestParameter(name = "actionDate", description = "Required if timing is SPECIFIC_DATE. "
545               + "E.g. 2023-11-30T16:16:47Z", isRequired = false, type = STRING),
546           @RestParameter(name = "cronTrigger", description = "Required if timing is REPEATING. "
547               + "https://www.quartz-scheduler.org/documentation/quartz-2.3.0/tutorials/crontrigger.html",
548               isRequired = false, type = STRING),
549           @RestParameter(name = "timing", description = "SPECIFIC_DATE, REPEATING, ALWAYS", isRequired = false,
550               type = STRING),
551           @RestParameter(name = "targetFilters", isRequired = false, description = "The filter(s) used to select "
552               + "applicable entities. Format: 'filter1:value1,filter2:value2'", type = TEXT),
553           @RestParameter(name = "accessControlEntries", description = "JSON. To find how to structure your JSON check "
554               + "the documentation.", isRequired = false, type = TEXT),
555       },
556       responses = {
557           @RestResponse(description = "Policy updated.", responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_OK),
558           @RestResponse(description = "The user doesn't have the rights to make this request.",
559               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN),
560           @RestResponse(description = "The request is invalid or inconsistent. Will also occur if the policy was "
561               + "created from configuration.",
562               responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST),
563       })
564   public Response updateAsJson(
565       @HeaderParam("Accept") String acceptHeader,
566       @PathParam("id") String id,
567       @FormParam("title") String title,
568       @FormParam("targetType") String targetType,
569       @FormParam("action") String action,
570       @FormParam("actionParameters") String actionParameters,
571       @FormParam("actionDate") String actionDate,
572       @FormParam("cronTrigger") String cronTrigger,
573       @FormParam("timing") String timing,
574       @FormParam("targetFilters") String targetFilters,
575       @FormParam("accessControlEntries") String accessControlEntries
576   ) {
577     try {
578       LifeCyclePolicy policy = service.getLifeCyclePolicyById(id);
579 
580       if (policy.isCreatedFromConfig()) {
581         return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
582       }
583 
584       List<String> actionParametersList = new ArrayList<>();
585       if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(actionParameters)) {
586         for (String actionParameter : StringUtils.split(actionParameters, ",")) {
587           actionParametersList.add(actionParameter);
588         }
589       }
590 
591       if (title != null && !title.isEmpty()) {
592         policy.setTitle(title);
593       }
594       if (targetType != null && !targetType.isEmpty()) {
595         policy.setTargetType(TargetType.valueOf(targetType));
596       }
597       if (action != null && !action.isEmpty()) {
598         policy.setAction(Action.valueOf(action));
599       }
600       if (actionParametersList != null && !actionParametersList.isEmpty()) {
601         // Check if action parameters are well formed
602         try {
603           if (Action.valueOf(action) == Action.START_WORKFLOW) {
604             StartWorkflowParameters actionParametersParsed = gson.fromJson(actionParameters,
605                 StartWorkflowParameters.class);
606             if (actionParametersParsed.getWorkflowId() == null) {
607               return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
608             }
609           }
610           policy.setActionParameters(actionParameters);
611         } catch (JsonSyntaxException e) {
612           return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
613         }
614       }
615       if (actionDate != null && !actionDate.isEmpty()) {
616         policy.setActionDate(EncodingSchemeUtils.decodeDate(actionDate));
617       }
618       if (cronTrigger != null && !cronTrigger.isEmpty()) {
619         CronParser unixParser = new CronParser(CronDefinitionBuilder.instanceDefinitionFor(CronType.UNIX));
620         Cron cron = unixParser.parse(cronTrigger);
621         CronMapper cronMapper = CronMapper.fromUnixToQuartz();
622         Cron cron4jCron = cronMapper.map(cron);
623         cronTrigger = cron4jCron.asString();
624 
625         policy.setCronTrigger(cronTrigger);
626       }
627       if (timing != null && !timing.isEmpty()) {
628         policy.setTiming(Timing.valueOf(timing));
629       }
630       if (targetFilters != null && !targetFilters.isEmpty()) {
631         Map<String, Map<String, EventSearchQueryField<String>>>  filtersMap;
632         if (targetFilters != null && !targetFilters.isEmpty()) {
633           try {
634             filtersMap = gson.fromJson(targetFilters,
635               new TypeToken<Map<String, Map<String, EventSearchQueryField<String>>>>() { }.getType());
636             if (filtersMap == null) {
637               filtersMap = new HashMap<>();
638             }
639             policy.setTargetFilters(filtersMap);
640           } catch (JsonSyntaxException e) {
641             return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
642           }
643         }
644       }
645       if (accessControlEntries != null && !accessControlEntries.isEmpty()) {
646         // Check if ACL is well formed
647         try {
648           List<LifeCyclePolicyAccessControlEntry> accessControlEntriesParsed = gson.fromJson(accessControlEntries,
649               new TypeToken<List<LifeCyclePolicyAccessControlEntryImpl>>() { }.getType());
650           if (accessControlEntriesParsed == null) {
651             accessControlEntriesParsed = new ArrayList<>();
652           }
653           policy.setAccessControlEntries(accessControlEntriesParsed);
654         } catch (JsonSyntaxException e) {
655           return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
656         }
657       }
658 
659       service.updateLifeCyclePolicy(policy);
660       return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).build();
661     } catch (NotFoundException e) {
662       return ApiResponseBuilder.notFound("Cannot find playlist instance with id '%s'.", id);
663     } catch (UnauthorizedException e) {
664       return Response.status(Response.Status.FORBIDDEN).build();
665     } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
666       return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST).build();
667     } catch (LifeCycleServiceException e) {
668       return Response.serverError().build();
669     }
670   }

672   @DELETE
673   @Path("policies/{id}")
674   @RestQuery(
675       name = "remove",
676       description = "Removes a lifecycle policy.",
677       returnDescription = "The removed lifecycle policy.",
678       pathParameters = {
679           @RestParameter(name = "id", isRequired = true, description = "Policy identifier", type = STRING)
680       },
681       responses = {
682           @RestResponse(responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_OK, description = "Policy removed."),
683           @RestResponse(responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND, description = "No lifecycle policy with that "
684               + "identifier exists."),
685           @RestResponse(responseCode = HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED, description = "Not authorized to perform "
686               + "this action")
687       })
688   public Response remove(
689       @HeaderParam("Accept") String acceptHeader,
690       @PathParam("id") String id) {
691     try {
692       service.deleteLifeCyclePolicy(id);
693       return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).build();
694     } catch (NotFoundException e) {
695       return ApiResponseBuilder.notFound("Cannot find policy instance with id '%s'.", id);
696     } catch (UnauthorizedException e) {
697       return Response.status(Response.Status.FORBIDDEN).build();
698     } catch (LifeCycleServiceException e) {
699       return Response.serverError().build();
700     }
701   }

703   private JsonObject policyToJson(LifeCyclePolicy policy) {
704     JsonObject json = new JsonObject();
705 
706     json.addProperty("id", policy.getId());
707     json.addProperty("title", safeString(policy.getTitle()));
708     json.addProperty("targetType", enumToJson(policy.getTargetType()));
709     json.addProperty("action", enumToJson(policy.getAction()));
710 
711     if (policy.getAction() == Action.START_WORKFLOW) {
712       json.addProperty("actionParameters", startWorkflowParametersToJson(policy.getActionParameters()).toString());
713     } else {
714       json.addProperty("actionParameters", safeString(policy.getActionParameters()));
715     }
716 
717     json.addProperty("actionDate", policy.getActionDate() != null ? toUTC(policy.getActionDate().getTime()) : "");
718     json.addProperty("cronTrigger", safeString(policy.getCronTrigger()));
719     json.addProperty("timing", enumToJson(policy.getTiming()));
720     json.addProperty("isActive", policy.isActive());
721     json.addProperty("isCreatedFromConfig", policy.isCreatedFromConfig());
722 
723     json.addProperty("targetFilters", gson.toJson(policy.getTargetFilters()));
724 
725 
726     JsonArray accessControlEntries = new JsonArray();
727     for (LifeCyclePolicyAccessControlEntry entry : policy.getAccessControlEntries()) {
728       accessControlEntries.add(policyAccessControlEntryToJson(entry));
729     }
730     json.add("accessControlEntries", accessControlEntries);
731 
732     return json;
733   }
734 
735   private JsonObject policyAccessControlEntryToJson(LifeCyclePolicyAccessControlEntry entry) {
736     JsonObject json = new JsonObject();
737     json.addProperty("id", entry.getId());
738     json.addProperty("allow", entry.isAllow());
739     json.addProperty("role", entry.getRole());
740     json.addProperty("action", entry.getAction());
741     return json;
742   }
743 
744   private JsonObject eventSearchQueryFieldToJson(EventSearchQueryField field) {
745     JsonObject json = new JsonObject();
746     json.addProperty("value", safeString(field.getValue()));
747     json.addProperty("type", safeString(field.getType()));
748     json.addProperty("must", field.isMust());
749     return json;
750   }
751 
752   private JsonObject startWorkflowParametersToJson(String jsonStr) {
753     StartWorkflowParameters parameters = gson.fromJson(jsonStr, StartWorkflowParameters.class);
754 
755     JsonObject json = new JsonObject();
756     json.addProperty("workflowId", parameters.getWorkflowId());
757 
758     String jsonString = "{" + parameters.getWorkflowParameters().entrySet().stream()
759         .map(entry -> {
760           String key = "\"" + entry.getKey() + "\"";
761           String value = entry.getValue();
762 
763           if ("true".equals(value) || "false".equals(value) || value.matches("-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?")) {
764             return key + ":" + value;
765           }
766 
767           String escaped = value.toString()
768               .replace("\\", "\\\\")
769               .replace("\"", "\\\"");
770           return key + ":\"" + escaped + "\"";
771         })
772         .collect(Collectors.joining(",")) + "}";
773     json.addProperty("workflowParameters", safeString(jsonString));
774 
775     return json;
776   }

778   private String enumToJson(Enum<?> e) {
779     return e != null ? e.toString() : null;
780   }
